title: A Comprehensive Framework to Operationalize Social Stereotypes for Responsible AI Evaluations

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the proposed five-component framework (Target Group, Attribute, Association, Perceiver, Context) to structure and analyze nationality-based stereotype instances from existing NLP datasets like SeeGULL and SBF.
Mapping occupational stereotype instances from the StereoLMs dataset into the paper's multidimensional stereotype operationalization framework.
Applying the proposed five-component framework to structure race-based stereotype instances from the StereoLMs and CrowsPairs datasets.
Mapping age-related stereotype instances from the StereoLMs and CrowsPairs datasets into the paper's unified stereotype framework.
Applying the proposed five-component framework to structure caste-based stereotype instances from the SPICE dataset.
Mapping regional stereotype instances from the SPICE dataset into the paper's multidimensional stereotype framework.
Applying the proposed five-component framework to structure disability-related stereotype instances from the CrowsPairs dataset.
Mapping sexual orientation stereotype instances from the Social Bias Frames (SBF) dataset into the paper's unified stereotype framework.
Applying the proposed five-component framework to structure gender-based stereotype instances from the Social Bias Frames (SBF) dataset.
